description: Explicit, specification-driven structural data harmonization. V1 supports ONLY declared operations on a frozen-source workflow: exact column rename; declared type coercion (numeric/integer/string/boolean/category); deterministic key normalization (trim/case/zero-pad); exact code/category mapping (no fuzzy); explicit date/year normalization; explicit unit conversion (source/target unit + factor); deterministic declared merge (1:1 / 1:m / m:1; m:m fails closed). It NEVER infers cleaning rules, NEVER imputes/winsorizes/deletes outliers, NEVER decides sample exclusion, NEVER defines treatment, NEVER constructs regression variables, and NEVER applies an eligibility flag to a final sample. Scientific decisions (sample exclusion / treatment definition) remain with the Director/study design. General formula-derived variables belong to economics.data.construct (M2).

references.name: DIME Data Handbook (World Bank) - data management / documentation / reproducibility
DIME Wiki - Data Management (deduplication, documentation, data cleaning discipline)

methodology.note: Structural, declared, auditable transformation. Consumes a frozen source + an explicit Domain harmonize plan; fails closed on ambiguity / scientifically material sample-affecting operations. No automatic cleaning/reparation; no invented rules.

verification.evidence: Tested (Phase-3 M3): real frozen Grunfeld companion + real-data-derived schema variant. Runtime-generated: harmonize of the derived variant (real_dataset_derived_schema_variant) into canonical-comparable firm-year panel (200 rows; firm 1..10; year 1935..1954; invest/value/capital values match canonical; deterministic output hash; canonical source unchanged). Independent expected-fact check vs canonical real dataset + deterministic synthetic Harmonize benchmark (rename/numeric/key/date/unit/merge) + adversarial (duplicate key, m:m, unmatched warn/fail, coercion failure, invalid date, unknown code, missing column, output collision, source-byte mutation, normalization-induced duplicate, row-count effect, plan/order mutation) + provenance/tamper + two-run prep chain determinism. M1 normalize_key collision guard fixed (pre-existing panel-id duplicates not misreported). Does NOT impute/winsorize/else; NOT verified; risk stays medium; fallback needs_decision. Owned by data role.
